articleTitle: Vision-based head posture control wheelchair system research
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In terms of interactive equipment with traditional man-machines, now it can directly realize human-computer interaction in the field of computer vision. In order to solve the problems of daily operations of disabled people, build a wheelchair control system combined by soft hardware. Users only need to use simple devices to complete the goals of daily operations. The control system mainly uses the real-time facial key point detection method of MediaPipe. Use a USB camera to achieve precise head posture estimation. For the error ratio of the algorithm, the average error ratio of the partial yaw angle obtained in the end is (0.0579), the average error ratio of the pitch angle is (0.0518), and the average error ratio of the roll angle is (0.0294). The maximum error is the yaw angle measurement angle (0.065), The overall error is within 1 degree to meet the requirements of experimental accuracy. The real-time motion control task of the wheelchair is completed through the non-contact human-computer interaction mode of camera head attitude estimation, and the wheelchair drive control is realized in the ROS system. Through experimental verification, the user successfully reaches the destination in a complex environment through head attitude control in a visual way, providing a solution to the human-computer interaction problem of the wheelchair; This can assist those with special disabilities, making it more user-friendly for real-time control of wheelchairs.

articleTitle: Design of A Rayleigh wave EMAT by using Racetrack Coil and Periodic Permanent Magnets
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Rayleigh waves are widely used for the detection and characterization of defects nearby the surface in the modern industries. Electromagnetic acoustic transducers (EMATs) have received extensive attention because of the lack of physical coupling. However, the main drawback of the inefficiency in generating and receiving ultrasonic waves restricts the extension and application of Rayleigh wave EMAT. This article proposes a type of Rayleigh wave electromagnetic acoustic transducer, which is consisted of a racetrack coil and a group of periodic permanent magnet array with a special configuration. The configuration of PPMs in the proposed EMAT is different from that in the common sheared-horizontal wave EMATs. The magnet units are magnetization along the width direction. The racetrack coil generates eddy current, and the periodic permanent magnet array provides bias static magnetic fields. The directions of generated Lorentz forces depend on the relative position between the magnet units and the conductors. The center frequency of the generated guided waves depends on the distance between the adjacent magnet units. In 2D FE simulations, different models were established, and the generation efficiencies for Rayleigh wave of vertical and horizontal Lorentz forces were compared. In the experiments, the guided wave EMAT, generating both horizontal and vertical Lorentz forces, was fabricated and used in the experiment system. The results prove the performance of the proposed EMAT for the effective generation Rayleigh waves.

articleTitle: An Omnidirectional EMAT Employing Spiral Coil and Annular Magnets for Enhanced Generation of A0 Mode Lamb Wave
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: As a typical noncontact ultrasonic testing method, electromagnetic ultrasonic guided wave testing has received extensive attention in recent years. However, the low energy efficiency and signal-to-noise ratio is especially obvious in omnidirectional electromagnetic acoustic transducers. To solve this problem for noncontact guided wave positioning detction, this article proposes an omnidirectional electromagnetic acoustic transducer (EMAT) for enhanced generation of A0 mode ultrasonic Lamb waves with pure mode in non-ferromagnetic plates. The proposed EMAT consists of a spiral coil and a group of annular magnets. The annular magnets build a special kind of periodic permanent magnets (PPM). The radius difference between the adjacent annular magnets is set to half the wavelength of the desire wave mode to maximize the excitation efficiency. In 2D axisymmetric FE simulations, the distribution of the bias magnetic fields and eddy currents was analyzed, and the mode of the generated guided waves was determined. In experiments, the omnidirectional EMATs were fabricated to verify the performance of generating omnidirectional A0 mode Lamb waves. The results prove the performance of the omnidirectional EMATs for effective generation of pure antisymmetric mode Lamb waves at specific frequency.

articleTitle: Dynamic monitoring method of oil pipeline leakage based on ultrasonic and optical fiber hybrid sensing technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: There is a big positioning error in oil pipeline leakage monitoring, so a dynamic monitoring method of oil pipeline leakage based on ultrasonic and optical fiber hybrid sensing technology is proposed. For a given arbitrary signal, the extreme points of all modal components are extracted; Solve the envelope of the maximum and minimum signal sets, decompose the modal components of the original virtual signal according to the average value of the original signal envelope, construct the dynamic monitoring process of oil pipeline leakage, match and classify, and finally achieve the purpose of locating the leakage point according to the oil pipeline pressure data, and realize the dynamic monitoring of oil pipeline leakage. The experimental results show that this method can quickly and accurately monitor the occurrence of leakage events, achieve the shortest alarm time and the smallest leakage positioning error, and have high positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: IoT-based Fire Mitigation and Detection System with AES-256 Encryption and Android Application
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In the Philippines, fires are one of the most destructive forces that plague its lands. The Bureau of Fire Protection tallied the incidents, injuries, and deaths caused by fires from 2013 to 2018. The losses incurred involve lives and assets across the country. The BFP faces issues in which it lacks the personnel, equipment, vehicles, and coverage when combatting fires. The IoT-based Fire Mitigation and Detection System with AES-256 Encryption and Android Application was developed to assist the Bureau in obtaining fire alerts. The system utilizes three sensors: (a) DHT22 Temperature and Humidity Sensor, (b) MQ2 Gas Sensor, and (c) MQ7 Gas Sensor. The general objective of the system is to acquire data from the household, primarily from its sensors, and transmit it to the Android application of the user and the Bureau. It displays the ambient temperature and gas levels while setting a threshold alerting both when it is exceeded. The system was tested in 100 trials, in which the system displays either Fire Hazard or No Fire Hazard. Using a confusion matrix for data evaluation, the system's Sensitivity is 85% and its Specificity is 100%.

articleTitle: A method for indoor and outdoor collaborative localization and mapping based on multi-sensors unmanned platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This paper focuses on target detection tasks in complex environments and explores a heterogeneous unmanned node cross-scenario precise detection method. Specifically, the paper unifies the location information detected by the platform entering the indoor environment to the local geographic frame where the swarm is located. In our design, a simple collaborative detection is achieved using a quadruped robot equipped with a laser radar for mapping and detection with its flexible mobility to enter the indoor environment, and a wheeled unmanned vehicle carrying high-precision IMU and GNSS to provide positioning benchmarks with its excellent load-carrying performance. The relative positions between unmanned platforms are calculated through UWB and depth camera, and the coordinates of the quadruped robot in the local geographic frame are successfully solved, thus inferring the location information of the indoor environment detected by the robot in the local geographic frame.

articleTitle: Research on Heart Rate Signal Recognition Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: As people’s living standards continue to improve, Cardiovascular disease has become one of the major diseases that pose a threat to human health. As one of the biological electrical signals produced by the human body, electrocardiogram (ECG) signals can intuitively reflect the health status of the heart, which is of great significance for the prevention and detection of cardiovascular diseases. This design is based on deep learning to identify abnormal heart rate signals and normal heart rate signals. The dataset comes from the public MIT-BIH dataset, and a time-frequency convolutional neural network is used to train the dataset. Compared with traditional long short-term memory networks, it has the characteristics of high recognition accuracy and fast convergence speed, which is of certain positive significance for related clinical applications.

articleTitle: NDIR-based low-cost integrated three-component gas detection system
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In this study, a low-cost miniature non-dispersive infrared (NDIR) three-component gas detector is developed, consisting of an infrared light source, a four-channel thermopile detector, a signal processing circuit, and an optical gas chamber. A low-noise conditioning filter circuit and a low-power 24-bit Σ∆ADC sampling circuit are designed to achieve a compact structure and real-time measurement of multiple gases. The concentration calculation model was derived using a non-linear least squares fit based on the Levenberg-Marquardt optimisation algorithm. The experimental results show that with an accuracy of 1.96% FS in the range of 0-2.5% vol for CH4 and 1.77% FS in the range of 0-3% vol for CO2, the system is capable of measuring gas concentrations relatively accurately and in real time while reducing cost.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of the Number of Nodes Constructing Underwater Sensor Barrier Deployed with Regular Polygon
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: To construct underwater warning and monitoring network in traffic direction restricted situations such as straits and ports, complex three-dimensional area coverage problem can be simplified as a three-dimensional underwater sensor barrier coverage problem. The sensor node detection model and coverage model are provided in the paper. Then the regular polygon non-loophole deployed nodes coverage model is discussed. The minimum number of sensor nodes deployed with non-loophole for a specific rectangle area are calculated by analytical method based on the model. The number of sensor nodes deployed with non-loophole for a specific trapezoid area is calculated by the same thought. According to the calculation results, it can be judged whether non-loophole coverage can be achieved, or optimization methods is necessary for specific number of sensor nodes to cover a rectangle area or a trapezoid area.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Navigation System of Small UAV Based on MEMS Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This paper uses inertial sensor-based inertial navigation system to loosely integrate with satellite navigation systems based on Beidou and GPS to construct an integrated navigation system. The navigation prototype is designed and manufactured. Data fusion between the two navigation systems is accomplished by Kalman filter algorithm. According to the precision condition of MEMS sensor, inertial navigation system mechanization and error model are established. Compared with the industrial integrated navigation system, the experimental results show that the navigation system designed in this paper has good static and dynamic measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: A method to enhance the low-frequency performance of geophone
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The velocity sensor is an important component of active damping systems and affects the accuracy and bandwidth of the control system. Velocity sensors with limited size lack accuracy in the low-frequency domain. To increase the velocity sensor measurement performance, this paper proposes a method that extends the low-frequency measurement bandwidth of the velocity sensor. Firstly, a mathematical model is established to obtain the physical characteristics of the sensor and analyze the factors affecting the measurement bandwidth. Secondly, an extended filtering method is introduced to match the sensor parameters and to design the sensor signal processing circuit based on theoretical calculation and simulation. Finally, a testing platform is set up and experiments are carried out. The results show that, for a given geophone with a natural frequency of 2Hz, the measurement bandwidth can be extended to 0.2Hz by using the proposed method.

articleTitle: High Performance Torque Sensing Element Based on Surface Acoustic Wave Resonator
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: SAW torque sensor is an important method in torque detection, and sensing element is an important part of sensor. Therefore, the design and analysis of the torque sensing element in SAW technology hold significant importance. In this study, The SAW torque sensing element was simulated and analyzed by finite element simulation software, the SAW torque sensing element was fabricated through the use of MEMS processes. Finally, the SAW torque testing platform was built, and the SAW torque sensing element was tested and analyzed. The results of three loading tests show that the sensitivity of SAW torque sensing element is 4.0045kHz/N•m, 4.0044kHz/N•m and 4.0011kHz/N•m. The results show that the designed SAW torque sensing element has good sensitivity and provide a good guidance for the application of SAW torque sensor.

articleTitle: Multiple Sensor Fusion-Based Positioning Robot for Steam Generator Inspection
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Nuclear energy is presently the clean energy source most likely to massively displace fossil energy, and the secondary side of the steam generator is an important part of a nuclear power plant. Due to the small space of the secondary side of the steam generator and the confinement of the vessel, the precise positioning of the robot inside the steam generator cannot be achieved by a single sensor alone. This paper introduces a multi-sensor fusion steam generator secondary side inspection robot. Primary emphasis is on data fusion of multiple sensors, such as laser sensors, cameras, IMU, and wheel encoder. First of all, this paper integrates data from wheel encoder data and IMU data by using extended Kalman filtering (EKF), which decreases the drift error during the motion and enhances the robot positioning precision. Afterwards, we incorporate laser ranging sensors and camera picture data to enhance the overall spatial sensitivity of the robot through particle filtering algorithms. Experiments show that the robot works reliably and has high positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Sensor Fault Detection for the Attitude Measurement System of Rotary Steerable Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The attitude measurement of drilling tools is essential to the control of rotary steering drilling tools. However, sensor faults seriously affect its measurement accuracy. Therefore, this article focuses on the problem of sensor fault detection under drilling disturbances in the attitude measurement system, ensuring the reliable operation of the measurement system. Firstly, the attitude measurement system including accelerometers and gyroscope is modeled as a linear system with unknown inputs, measurement noise and parameter uncertainties. These bounded disturbances are described by zonotopes. Secondly, a set membership unknown input observer generating residual in finite frequency domain is proposed. In order to make the residual sensitive to faults and robust to disturbances, design conditions for observer gain are given based on the P-radius criterion and generalized KYP lemma. Then, based on whether the boundary of the residual cross zero, it is determined whether sensor faults have occurred in the system. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method was verified through experiments, and the results show that the method successfully detected accelerometer and gyroscope faults.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of a Low Consumption and Wide Output Swing Eight Transistors Active Pixel Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: For a complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor image sensor with high accuracy, low noise and low power consumption, the extension of output swing and low power design techniques are becoming very significant. The paper analyzes the principles of pixel output swing limitation and then proposes a novel Eight Transistors Active Pixel Sensor with wide output swing and low power consumption characteristics. Using the slow-decay technique to suppress the impact of clock feedthrough on the output swing. The prototype pixel has been fabricated in a 0.18µm Complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) standard process, the pixel parameters were validated using a 400,000-pixels array global shutter CMOS image sensor. Results show that the proposed Eight Transistors Active Pixel Sensor (8T-APS) is optimized that the output swing reaches 776mV and the power consumption is only 100nA with 3.3V supply. This method is particularly suitable for large-array global shutter image sensors.

articleTitle: SINS/Odometer/LDV Fault Tolerant Integrated Navigation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Traditional vehicle SINS/Odometer integrated navigation uses Hall odometer and other sensors to measure vehicle wheel speed. The navigation errors increased obviously when the vehicle slides. A method that the vehicle body velocity directly measured by laser Doppler velocimeter (LDV) is added to the traditional vehicle SINS/Hall-Odometer integrated navigation is presented. The SINS error model, the odometers error model and the LDV error model are considered. The integrated navigation model of SINS/odometer/LDV is built by using the incremental mileage difference in the filter period as the observation. To meet the requirements of high reliability integrated navigation, residual χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> fault detection method is adopted to detect Hall odometer and LDV fault. The actual vehicle integrated navigation experiment is carried out. The results show that the positioning accuracy is still high when the output of Hall odometer or LDV is interrupted.

articleTitle: Piezo-Electret Capacitive Micromachined Ultrasonic Transducers based on BTO-doped PVDF film
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In order to solve the shortcomings of the capacitive micromachined ultrasonic transducer requiring an external bias voltage, the Piezo-Electret Capacitive Micromachined Ultrasonic Transducers was designed. It was based on the capacitive micromachined ultrasonic transducer. The piezoelectric/electret material layer was added to the diaphragm of the capacitive micromechanical ultrasonic transducer, then the electret was used to store charge to provide an electrostatic field, and the signal was enhanced by the positive and inverse piezoelectric effect. Therefore, it could reduce or even remove the bias voltage required for the transducer. After experimental verification, the new transducer can transmit ultrasonic waves without external bias voltage, and complete the reception of ultrasonic waves with the addition of small voltage assistance.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor Fusion Based Inspection Robotic Dog Safety Guardian and Navigation Application
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Aiming at the system security problems and potential risks existed in the navigation and positioning algorithm of test and inspection robot in power grid, a multi-source fusion robust positioning and high-fidelity simulation method for inspection robots is proposed. Multi-sensor fusion algorithms, integration of fault detection and information recovery algorithms, and validation and testing in simulated smart grid scenarios. The research and application of robot dog in the quality control of substation technical reform and overhaul project are explained. Finally, the autonomous navigation and safety monitoring mode of the robot dog is designed.

articleTitle: Adaptive Active Fault-tolerant Control for Aero-engine Actuator Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of aero-engine control system, an active fault-tolerant control system is designed to realize effective fault diagnosis and fault-tolerant control, so that the control system can maintain the stability of the engine even when the actuator fails. This paper takes the control system of a type of two-rotor engine as the research object, establishes the linear model of the control system, and establishes the mathematical description of the control system with the fault of the actuator. An adaptive fault detection observer is designed, and on the basis of fault detection, an active fault-tolerant control system based on adaptive fault diagnosis observer is designed. An adaptive fault estimation algorithm is established to realize real-time fault estimation, and the compensation control law is designed to offset the influence of faults on the system and restore the normal performance of the system.

articleTitle: Self-calibration Method of Circular Grating Error in Rotary Inertial Navigation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: To investigate the impact of circular grating measurement errors on attitude output accuracy in rotary inertial navigation systems (INS), this paper analyzes the main error sources of circular grating in INS. Specifically, the coaxial error of circular grating and inertial measurement unit, as well as the installation eccentricity error of circular grating, are examined and their error models are presented based on their physical characteristics. Next, a self-calibration method for circular grating errors is proposed using the high-precision angle measuring ability of the laser gyro in the IMU. This method does not require any external equipment and utilizes inertial navigation itself. Calibration of the coaxial error of circular grating is achieved through the orthogonal characteristics of three gyros in the IMU, while calibration of the installation eccentricity error is accomplished using the high-precision angle measuring of the IMU. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of this self-calibration method, reducing the measurement error of circular grating from 35" to 5". This level of accuracy meets the requirements for self-calibration in high-precision inertial navigation.

articleTitle: A Design Approach of Surface Coil Element and Multi-Channel Array to Improve Magnetic Field with High Uniformity for 1.5T MRI
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In this paper, an 8-channel radio frequency (RF) coil array for 1.5T magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is proposed, which consists of a combination of eight surface coil elements with high magnetic field uniformity. The proposed surface coil elements incorporate a semicircular design at both ends based on the rectangular coils, which can significantly improve the surface current inhomogeneity and RF magnetic field inhomogeneity caused by single-ended excitation. The proposed 8-channel array has better B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>- field uniformity and receive sensitivity. Compared to the standard head birdcage coil, the peak B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-/√p strength can be enhanced by 89.25%, and the mean value of B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-/√p field can be enhanced by 20.14%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Compressed Air Quality Detection System for Tobacco-curing
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Compressed air system is a very important system in cigarette factory, and the water content of the compressed air determine the product quality of the cigarette factory directly. The quality of compressed air for tobacco-curing is difficult to guarantee. Therefore, in order to measure the water content of compressed air accurately, the idea of online detection of compressed air quality for tobacco-curing is proposed. In this paper, the design process of compressed air quality detection system is described in detail from the aspects of design idea, implementation scheme and experimental verification. The experimental results show that the compressed air quality detection system designed can realize the online detection of compressed air quality accurately and ensure the quality of compressed air.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional Model-driven Robot Digital Twin System
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In order to achieve the goal of accurately simulating physical entities and meet the service and application requirements of digital twins, a multidimensional model-driven approach for digital twin robots is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the geometric model of the robot is constructed based on the physical space. Secondly, the constraints and physical characteristics of the robot’s physical model are determined using the Denavit-Hartenberg (D-H) method. Then, the kinematic model is built based on the D-H parameters provided by the physical model to determine the behavioral model. Finally, an experimental platform is established with a virtual space update rate of 100 Hz, and trajectory verification is conducted, with relative position errors of 0.34%, 0.41%, and 0.22% for the X, Y, and Z axes respectively. The results demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of this method in digital twin systems.

articleTitle: Sensor strategy of electrical impedance tomography for carbon fiber reinforced plastic plate
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: As a new type of high-performance material, Carbon fiber reinforced plastic (CFRP) has been widely used in aerospace and many other fields. The detection of damage during its service has attracted serious concern from researchers. Electrical impedance tomography (EIT) is an internal detection technology that has been widely used in many fields such as medicine and multiphase flow monitoring. Because of its advantages of online detection and real-time monitoring, it has high application potential in the field of non-destructive testing and structural health monitoring, which has aroused the interest of scholars. Conventional EIT studies are mostly carried out on circular measurement domains, conventional sensor strategies of EIT system may not be applicable to CFRP structures in plate shapes. In this paper, the sensor strategy of EIT is investigated for the CFRP structure of plate shape. Three electrode array distribution strategies are proposed, and the damage image reconstruction results are compared by simulation. The results show that when the sensors are located on the upper and lower surfaces of the CFRP plate, it not only has a more uniform sensitivity distribution, but also obtains high-precision image reconstruction results containing depth direction information.

articleTitle: Underwater Acoustic Target Classification and Grading Technology Based on Track Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Aiming at the prominent problem of low accuracy of underwater acoustic target recognition based on acoustic features, we propose to fuse and use non-acoustic information to improve the confidence of target recognition. In this paper, an underwater acoustic target recognition technology based on acoustic and non-acoustic information fusion is proposed to tackle the problems of difficult track association and insufficient fusion probability model support in the process of acoustic and non-acoustic information fusion. This technology uses the improved target-tracking grey relational analysis (GRA) method to associate the tracks of low-frequency sonar targets, high-frequency sonar targets, and non-acoustic targets. The track information after association is fused based on Dempster-Shafer (D-S) evidence theory to give the non-threat assessment results of targets. Finally, the expert system is used to fuse the recognition results based on the line spectrum feature template matching of target radiated noise with the target non-threat assessment results based on acoustic and non-acoustic track fusion, so as to improve the accuracy of target recognition. The simulation results of the improved target-tracking GRA is shown and the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by sea trial data.

articleTitle: Design And Implementation of A Kind of Miniaturized Digital Pressure Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Facing the need of small volume and digital sensor in the field of aerospace, a low-cost miniaturized digital pressure sensor is designed based on SOI Piezoresistive Technology and Hybrid Integrated Circuit. A sensitive element structure is designed to solve the technical problem of miniaturization of pressure sensors. The combination of MCU STM32F030 and sensor signal conditioner NSA2860 realizes the high-resolution measurement of pressure parameters by designing a hardware circuit of digital sensor. The outer diameter of the miniaturized sensor does not exceed 14mm, the weight is not more than 30g, and the measuring range covers 1Mpa-40Mpa. Finally, the reliability test of the sensor is carried out, and the test results show that the environmental adaptability of the sensor can meet the equipment requirements.

articleTitle: A Local Obstacle Avoidance Method for Unmanned Surface Vehicle Based on Acceleration and Angular Velocity
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The traditional obstacle avoidance algorithm is based on position control. The ideal obstacle avoidance trajectory is derived by ship model. However, unmanned surface vehicle (USV) is an underactuated mission-driven system, and the cost of deviating from the predetermined path should be considered in the course of obstacle avoidance. Moreover, the actual motion path is often the result of the combined action of manual, automatic navigation and obstacle avoidance algorithms, which makes it difficult to obtain an accurate motion model. In this paper, the boundary between safety and danger is deduced from angle and distance, collision warning range is set, and new obstacle state parameters are defined. Then, the risk factors of different obstacles were quantified within the collision warning range, and the optimal course angle deviation and acceleration values were obtained, which were respectively output to the rudder angle controller and throttle controller. Simulation and real ship verification of the proposed algorithm show that the proposed method can effectively avoid obstacles and return to the preset track.

articleTitle: Practical analysis of PID control and switching control in constant value temperature control system
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The purpose of constant value temperature control system is to make the temperature of the controlled object constant at a certain value, for the specific temperature control system, there are many control methods can achieve good control effect, control methods are not the same. Based on PID control and switching control, this paper describes its control principle and method, the selection of supporting relays, applicable occasions and other specific use cases, and provides ideas, choices and references for personnel who are about to do constant value temperature control systems

articleTitle: A multi-sensor schedule and radiation control method based on RWSO algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: To address the radiation risk problem in the sensor system during target tracking, we present a long-term scheduling method of radiation cooperative positioning under multi-sensor platform. First, quantify the tracking accuracy and radiation risk, which is associated with the distance between the sensor and the target, the transmitted power. Second, design the optimization variables including discrete variables and continuous variables, and the target optimization function balanced tracking accuracy with radiation risk. Finally, considering the effect of local decisions, establish the sensor forward scheduling model and solve the scheduling scheme by the war strategy algorithm based on the inverse learning mechanism. Simulation results show that the proposed scheduling method can effectively balance tracking precision and radiation risk, and realize radiation risk control in target tracking process.

articleTitle: Sensorless Vector Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Extended Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This article considers adopting a dual closed-loop control strategy based on id=0 for permanent magnet synchronous motors. In order to address the problem of using sensorless methods to detect rotor information in permanent magnet synchronous motor speed control systems, an extended Kalman filtering algorithm is used to filter and estimate rotor speed and position on the basis of speed and current dual closed-loop vector control, replacing the detection device used to calculate speed and rotor position. In response to the problem of filtering divergence and insufficient accuracy of estimation results in the estimation process of the extended Kalman filter, a scheme combining the extended Kalman filter algorithm with modern control strategies is used to suppress the divergence phenomenon in the estimation process, improve estimation accuracy, and further improve the control performance of permanent magnet synchronous motors. The influence of different values of the Q and R matrices on the system is studied, and verified through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Comparative study of navigation noise immunity based on Kalman filter
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This study aims to explore the influence of noise in multimodal sensor analysis on the prediction performance of the Kalman filter, and to compare a number of different prediction methods for predicting navigation information (car trajectory).First, in order to verify the superiority of the Kalman filter, we try to compare the results of the Kalman filter with a variety of other prediction methods, including linear regression, neural networks and random forest, and by comparing it with the Kalman filter, we find that the Kalman filter can better adapt to the noise environment and provide more accurate prediction results of the fitted trajectory. Next, we simulate various noise situations of multimodal sensors in real environments by introducing noise of different intensities. We then used the Kalman filter for trajectory prediction and evaluated its performance at different noise levels. The results show that the Kalman filter has good predictive performance in the face of low to moderate intensity noise, but in In summary, this study evaluates the influence of noise on the prediction performance of the Kalman filter through multimodal sensor analysis, and compares a number of different prediction methods. The results show that other prediction methods may be more suitable for predicting navigation information than Kalman filters in specific noise environments. These findings provide a valuable reference for the development of more accurate and robust navigation systems in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-objective Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Scheme Based on Discrete Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-objective discrete particle swarm optimization algorithm (agsMODPSO) based on an adaptive grid strategy for Multi-objective flexible job shop scheduling problems taking into account production costs. The algorithm introduces the Pareto domination relation to evaluate particles, establishes an external archive set to store non-dominated solutions, and performs adaptive grid division on the external archive set. The external archive set is maintained by a mixed strategy of adaptive grid and crowding distance, and the global optimal solution is selected based on this strategy. Applying the agsMODPSO algorithm to a practical case for solving the problem demonstrated the feasibility and effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A mobile industrial robot design
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In this thesis, we focus on the chassis design and barrier traversal structure of a logistics distribution robot with four independent driving shop floor wheels, and establish a three-dimensional model. The chassis design with four independent driving wheels and an independent steering structure is primarily performed to realize the omnidirectional motion of the workshop logistics robot; the design of the barrier crossing mechanism allows the robot to have a barrier crossing function and be able to work in more complex road conditions, and it is verified that the robot meets the design requirements via Adams simulation.

articleTitle: A Liquid Mass Measurement Method for the Experimental Aircraft Center of Gravity Adjustment System Based on Bayesian Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Aiming at safety and reliability requirements of the experimental aircraft center of gravity adjustment system that adjusts the center of gravity of aircraft by adjusting the liquid mass distribution of tank groups in a flight test, the shortcomings of the current method for measuring liquid mass in tank groups are analyzed. A multi-sensor fusion method based on Bayesian theory is presented by combining pressure sensors and liquid level sensors. Firstly, the mathematical model of multi-sensor fusion is established, and the principle of consistency detection is designed. Then the effective data are fused by Bayesian method to obtain the optimal fusion result. Finally, the experiment result shows that the aircraft center of gravity adjustment system based on multi-sensor fusion can effectively eliminate the failure information and obtain reliable liquid mass measurement which ensures the correct calculation and adjustment of aircraft center of gravity and ensures the safety of flight test.

Author Keywords: experimental aircraft center of gravity adjustment system

articleTitle: Research on parameter optimization configuration of ZJ119 high speed cigarette unit based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In view of the characteristics of multiple parameters of ZJ119 high-speed cigarette unit, the optimal configuration method of ZJ119 high-speed cigarette unit parameters based on cigarette materials was studied. Relevant data were collected, data collection and processing schemes were proposed, and the correlation between cigarette material parameters and cigarette machine tuning parameters, cigarette machine tuning parameters and cigarette quality indexes were analyzed. The data were classified by correlation analysis, and the BP neural network model was input for parameter training and prediction. After many times of research and prediction, all the data that meet the requirements of cigarette quality index are collected, made into line chart for data analysis, and the optimal configuration data of cigarette machine parameters are selected. The method is simple and feasible. The parameters of cigarette machine can be adjusted according to the material parameters and quality index, and the parameters can be optimized to make the product quality index stable.

articleTitle: Design of portable refrigerator based on DS18B20 temperature sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The design uses STC89C52RC microcontroller and semiconductor cooler to design portable refrigerator, using DS18B20 temperature sensor module, SSD1306 OLED display module, relay and aluminum heat sink. It realizes the function of portable refrigerator to control the cooler and display the temperature individually. The temperature measurement module will test the real-time temperature inside the portable refrigerator after turning on the portable refrigerator; the switch of the air-cooled radiator and the switch of the semiconductor cooling fins are controlled by the principle of weak power controlling strong power. Portable refrigerator is able to design different functions according to different needs or environment. This design of portable refrigerator can reduce the temperature of items in a short period of time outdoors. The portable refrigerator which uses the semiconductor refrigeration sheet has a simple refrigeration structure and no pollutant generation, which is in line with people's pursuit of green environment.

articleTitle: High frequency heat sealing system in-situ power detection device
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In order to address the issues of low accuracy, high insertion loss, and difficulty in recording results of the power measurement device for high-frequency thermal sealing systems, this paper designs an in-situ power detection device for high-frequency thermal sealing systems based on a dual directional coupler. The high-frequency low-power signal is coupled by the dual-directional coupler, which is converted to the voltage signal by the attenuator. The RF relay can also be controlled to disconnect the attenuator to expand the detection range. Calculate the corresponding forward power and reflected power based on the calibrated quantitative relationship between voltage and power, and display them on the serial port screen. After testing, the designed power detection device has a small impact on the output power of the high-frequency heat sealing system, has high measurement accuracy, and the measurement error is less than 0.13 dB at the operating frequency of the system, with insertion loss as low as 0.04 dB.

articleTitle: Compound Fuzzy Control Technology Based on Biological Nature for Driving Birds
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: A compound feedforward control strategy is designed basing on flying birds biological nature in this paper, that makes detection sensing equipment and driving away equipment focus on the flying birds above the airport, such as photoelectric equipment to catch flying birds image and strong sound equipment or laser equipment drive away flying birds off the airport. Fuzzy controller is modeled mathematically by using bird vector flight speed, flying birds biological characteristics and flight state of flying birds. According to the stimulated behavior and random behavior of flying birds, fuzzy control rule base is established, and the fuzzy threshold of bird turning is defined basing on flying birds biological nature, and the feedforward control strategy is applied for unexpected action related to the fuzzy threshold. One adaptive feedforward unit based on the pan-tilt rotation model, which is added on the control strategy on fast PID algorithm to less local instability and improve complex dynamic behavior control result. By this way, the detection sensing equipment and driving away equipment can respond quickly under the condition of the flying bird changing direction suddenly, so that whole system can continue tracking the flying bird target and avoid series problems as loss of flying bird target by unexpected action of flying birds for disturbed item or biological nature. It fulfills the function of driving away the flying birds above the airport which can protect the safety of airplane and passengers.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of HVAC laboratory based on co-simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: In the context of the rapid development of co-simulation, this paper designs and implements an HVAC laboratory based on the co-simulation research, which realizes the co-simulation of device controller and FMU simulation model through the combination of reality and virtual, and establishes a virtual simulation laboratory to test the performance of device controller and assist in learning HVAC principles. In this paper, the author use LabVIEW language to focus on the data channel of co-simulation, data integration and data storage after the combination of reality and imagination, so that the users realize the influence of controller input parameters on the model and the influence of model output parameters on the controller in the interface and realize dynamic adjustment.

articleTitle: Defect Detection of Steam Pipelines Using Infrared Thermal Imaging Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Steam pipelines is one of the important power sources in factories such as cigarette factories, and it is necessary to detect whether the piping leaks through infrared thermography. In order to improve the accuracy of detection, the steam pipelines model is established, and the surface temperature of the pipelines is simulated and analyzed under different working conditions. In order to provide a theoretical basis for the infrared thermal imaging sensor to detect whether the steam pipeline leakage, according to the simulation results and infrared thermal imaging sensor data can accurately determine whether the pipeline leakage and the type of defects.

articleTitle: Digital twin-based quality inspection system for low-voltage current transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The measuring current transformer is a type of current transformer that provides current to electric energy meters and similar appliances. It is mainly used for measuring current in low-voltage distribution systems and has the characteristics of a wide range of applications, a large number of users, and numerous model parameters. However, the quality of measuring current transformers used in distribution network lines is uneven, with a high failure rate and a propensity for explosions or combustion. To address this issue, it is necessary not only to conduct strict testing on the operation of measuring current transformers, but also to perform comprehensive performance testing on incoming measuring current transformers before they are connected to the network. Sampling and performing comprehensive performance testing on low-voltage measuring current transformers from various manufacturers requires a large amount of testing equipment and constant relocation of corresponding testing equipment based on specific testing items, resulting in a massive workload. This paper proposes a comprehensive performance testing system for low-voltage measuring current transformers, which enables comprehensive and effective testing of low-voltage current transformers.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser-induced flexible and highly sensitive capacitive pressure sensor with treefrog suckers bionic microstructure
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Flexible capacitive pressure sensors are optimal for wearable electronic equipment owing to their advantages of simplicity in architecture and low power consumption. However, fabricating a bionic flexible capacitive pressure sensor with high sensitivity and a wide dynamic range of detection is still a great challenge. In this article, we propose a flexible pressure sensor based on femtosecond laser ablation with a treefrog suckers bionic microstructure. The treefrog suckers capacitive pressure sensor (TSCPS) has high sensitivity (0-10 kPa, 0.0762 kPa<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>), wide detection range (500 kPa), high repeatability (>12000 s at 10 kPa), and fast response time (62.5 ms). For practical applications, the TSCPS was positioned on the wrist, palm, and sole of the hand to detect the movements of each part accordingly. The experimental findings indicate that the TSCPS has broad promising applications in bionic wearable products such as human locomotion monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on Calibration of Steam Thermometers in Cigarette Factory Based on LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Temperature instruments have been widely used in the current industrial environment, but there are also some problems with temperature instruments. For example, when the current conditions change, temperature instruments may have certain accuracy issues. However, in industrial environments, it is difficult for temperature instruments to ensure that the working environment they face does not change. On the basis of existing conditions, this article proposes using neural networks to calibrate temperature instruments, making their accuracy higher. This method is beneficial for improving the quality and stability of products, and strengthening production safety.

articleTitle: Research on SLAM Mapping for Multi sensor Fusion in Smart Factories
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Mapping is a core function for mobile robots to carry out their work in smart factories, and the traditional mapping method is generally realized by using a single sensor, which suffers from the problems of large error and insufficient robustness to the scene with missing features. A simultaneous localization and map building (SLAM) method for the fusion of LiDAR and depth camera information is proposed to address the problems of traditional methods. The implementation of this method is divided into the following steps: first, the dense point cloud thread is added to the ORB-SLAM3 algorithm, and the depth camera is used to collect the surrounding environment information to generate the dense point cloud map of the environment; second, the dense point cloud map is converted into an octree map to finally generate the visual 2D raster map, and the laser 2D raster map is obtained by the Gmapping algorithm; lastly, the Gaussian process-based Finally, the 2D raster maps are fused and updated using Bayesian estimation based on Gaussian process. The experiments are conducted in Robot Operating System (ROS), and the experimental results show that the method effectively overcomes the limitation of a single sensor, and the resulting environment maps are closer to the actual environment, which effectively improves the robustness of SLAM mapping.

articleTitle: Design of traction system for urban rail simulation device
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traction system of urban rail train cannot intuitively understand the working principle of the control circuit in the conventional theoretical explanation and the static training mode of the original train and can only meet the simple operation problems such as theoretical research and no physical simulation, a design scheme of modular and transparent control circuit for urban rail train traction system is introduced. The design ideas of reducing voltage and simplifying circuit are used to integrate the gating system in the electrical cabinet, and the analog signal is converted into digital signal by the DSP monitoring module between the electronic gating unit and the terminal display module. The terminal display module receives, stores and displays the electrical parameters of the door state such as the motor current curve, distance / time, and fault code, so as to achieve the purpose of real-time monitoring of the door state, fault simulation processing, and student process assessment.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Underground Natural Gamma Measurement While Drilling System
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: With the continuous development of the coal mining industry, the coal mining environment is becoming worse and worse, and the gas extraction problem is faced in the mining process. The gas extraction along the coal seam is the most efficient method to solve the safety problems caused by gas in the mining process. This paper introduces a mine-used logging while drilling instrument for measuring the directional data of boreholes and the formation characteristics data of natural gamma measurement. The instrument is mainly used for real-time monitoring of drilling trajectory and formation rock related parameters. Therefore, it can not only detect the geological classification and stability in coal mine production, but also control the safety problems such as gas explosion and bottom water that may occur in the mining environment. After the downhole signal is collected by the sensor and processed by filtering and noise reduction, the measured data can be plotted and displayed on the computer <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>.

articleTitle: Influence of the Electric Field Distribution on the Rotating Optical Voltage Sensors and Optimization Measures Research
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The measurement results of the Rotating Optical Voltage Sensor (ROVS) based on the Pockels effect are influenced by the electric field distribution of the electro-optical crystal. In this paper, we analyze the influence of electric field distribution on the sensor measurement from the perspective of optical offset, and the results show that the electric field inside the rotating crystal is inhomogeneous and fluctuating, which causes the sensor measurement error. In order to solve the above problems, the paper adopts a cylindrical electro-optical crystal and wraps a glass medium to effectively eliminate the electric field fluctuation and improve the electric field distribution uniformity at the same time. The simulation results show that the maximum integral voltage error is reduced from 1.509% to 0.536% when the incident light angle is shifted by 0.1 rad, and the maximum error is reduced from 0.187% to 0.005% when the position is shifted by 2 mm.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Accuracy Using the Modified Error Vector Magnitude for Impedance Measurements
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Data-driven models can often be modeled based on external characteristics without the need to know the internal structure and control methods of the model. The challenge is that the measurements impedance data cannot be evaluated without unify process. The definition of error in vector measurements is explained. Meanwhile, three dominant accuracy criteria are presented and compared. Finally, the method proposed in this paper is validated by test set data. Improvements are proposed for the measurement accuracy of two-dimensional vectors, which are expected to be helpful for future data analysis.

articleTitle: A Rate Integrating Hemispherical Resonant Gyro Angular Rate Output Method Based on Frequency Demodulation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The rate integrating hemispherical gyro is a new type of solid vibration gyro, and the output method of the gyro directly affects its performance. In this paper, the control method of rate integrating hemispherical gyro is introduced at first, and the existing angular rate output method is given. On this basis, an angular rate output method based on frequency demodulation is proposed. This method decomposes the standing wave of the hemispherical resonator into clockwise and counter-clockwise traveling waves, and the angular rate output is realized by caulating the frequency of the clockwise and counter-clockwise traveling waves. This article compares two angular rate output methods through experiments, and the experimental results demonstrate that the angular rate output method based on frequency demodulation effectively suppresses the output noise, and further improves the angular rate output accuracy of the rate integral hemispherical gyro.

articleTitle: A Lightweight and Precise Muzzle Velocity Measurement Method Based on Geomagnetic Sensor in Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Muzzle velocity is one of the important parameters of projectile trajectory position and burst point control. In order to solve the problem of large interference deviation in the acquisition of muzzle velocity in an actual complex environment, a measurement method of muzzle velocity in the complex environment based on a geomagnetic sensor is proposed. This method carries out offline training before the projectile is launched on the projectile-borne geomagnetic sensor. The type of fitting function is determined by trajectory simulation of the projectile speed. The work on the line fits and converts the muzzle velocity test data according to the law to obtain the muzzle velocity. The simulation and experimental results show that the muzzle velocity measurement method can effectively improve the measurement accuracy of the muzzle velocity compared with the current method. This method's operation with high complexity is carried out offline, which is of great significance for the velocity measurement of the flying body limited by weak hardware.

articleTitle: Calibration platform design for combined magnetic encoder
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: The seeker is the core device used by cruise missiles to achieve autonomous tracking of targets and guidance of the loitering munition. Generally speaking, a dual frame structure is adopted, and the joint linkage of the inner and outer frames achieves the angle deviation of the imaging system relative to the missile body. The rotation angle of the frame platform is measured by a magnetic encoder installed on the rotating end of the frame. In order to achieve high accuracy and resolution, magnetic encoders are difficult to achieve solely through hardware design and require the use of a series of software algorithms. This article designs and builds a new calibration experimental platform, which uses a new signal processing method based on calibration principles and uses the lookup table method to calibrate the encoder. This platform improves the angular displacement detection accuracy of the combined magnetic encoder, which can greatly improve the performance of loitering munition.

articleTitle: Flexible Capacitive Pressure Sensors and Their Applications in Human-Machine Interactions
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Flexible capacitive pressure sensors have shown excellent application potential in human-machine interactions, wearable electronic devices, biological and medical, and electronic skin. Compared with piezoresistive and piezoelectric pressure sensors, capacitive pressure sensors with advantages such as high flexibility, high stability, low consumption, and simple construction. Because of these advantages, flexible capacitive pressure sensors have become the key research direction of pressure sensors in recent years. This paper introduces the working principle of flexible capacitive pressure sensors and discusses numerous research on improving the performance of flexible capacitive pressure sensors. Then two methods of improving the dielectric layer structures to improve the sensitivity of the sensor and some related works are reviewed. Finally, the flexible capacitive pressure sensors' huge potential for advances in human-machine interactions areas such as health care and motion monitoring is also discussed. The paper concludes with an overview of future research directions of improving the performance of flexible capacitive pressure sensors.

articleTitle: Design and modeling of control strategy for extended-range electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: This study describes the characteristics and structure of an extended range electric car, examines the operating mode, and develops the general control strategy, drive mode, and braking mode. Then, using CRUISE and MATLAB software, construct the vehicle simulation model and the vehicle control strategy model, complete the dynamic and economic simulation, and compare the results with the comprehensive consumption of fuel simulation utilizing the thermostat managing strategy; after the comparison analysis, the comprehensive fuel consumption and comprehensive driving cost under the multi-working point control strategy decreased by 5.78%, which is more in line with the economics.

articleTitle: Window-optimized Lidar Odometry Based on Self-supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Lidar SLAM, especially 3D Lidar SLAM, can effectively solve the problem of scale consistency due to its 3D observation information. The learning-based approach does not need to rely on the initial value of ICP iterations, which is often not easily accessible. The neural network approach can use the network structure to model the random errors in the real environment. The traditional supervised learning-based method requires an accurate bit-posture truth value, which is costly and not obtainable in unique scenarios. For the learning-based method, Lidar odometry is often based on the solution between two frames of point clouds. Constructing a particular loss function is beneficial to solve the noise introduced by moving objects for the matching solver. By the self-supervised approach, the information about the data itself can be fully utilized. In this paper, we improve deep learning laser odometry by taking advantage of self-supervised learning of ground-truth data without calibration. Our main work is inspired by the sliding window algorithm, we introduce a multi-frame Lidar point cloud synchronization approach, introducing an attention mechanism (offset-attention) for noise suppression, introducing the LSTM algorithm to fully use the continuous trajectory information to obtain the global bit pose estimation and introducing a self-supervised adversarial mechanism based on point cloud segmentation makes the self-supervised process more robust and fast convergence.

articleTitle: Application of ideal gas state equation in temperature and pressure measuring instrument
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Temperature sensors and pressure sensors are commonly used in the field of industrial control and measurement. Based on the ideal gas state equation, the variation coefficient of temperature and volume, the variation coefficient of pressure and volume in the equation are decomposed. The law of volume expansion and contraction caused by temperature change and the law of volume expansion and contraction caused by pressure are obtained. Combined with the influence of temperature and pressure conditions on the amount of β-ray, the ' ideal gas measurement equation ' of energy change on β-ray sensor caused by temperature and pressure is obtained, which is used as the measurement model of temperature and pressure sensor. The feasibility of the method is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: A Numerical Analytical Model for Multi-Ion Detection Applied to Solid-State Contact Ion-Selective Electrode Array
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Sensor Technology and Control (ISSTC)
abstract: Water is a basic component of nature and an important substance for the survival of the biosphere. With the development of science and technology and people's increasing concern for the environment, the demand for water quality testing is increasing. Driven by the progress of micromachining technology, the solid contact ion selective electrode (SC-ISE) was born and flourished, gradually replacing the traditional liquid contact ion selective electrode. In particular, it has the characteristics of high integration and simple process, and more and more related portable online detection applications have been reported. However, most of the current applications are based on the selectivity of the ion-selective membrane itself, and the interference problem is ignored in specific scenarios, which reduces the accuracy of the detection results and limits the application scenarios. Based on the experimental phenomena, this paper proposes a numerical model to analyze the ion concentration problem in the scenario where multiple ions interfere with each other. In addition, a parallel channel data selection method is proposed to reduce the impact of accidental errors. As a carrier, we designed a multi-ion and multi-channel solid contact ion-selective electrode array to detect calcium, magnesium, sodium and potassium ions in actual water samples, and compared with the high-precision ICP-OES detection results. The scientificity and applicability of the numerical model are verified within the acceptable range of error.
